headline: Life changed? Check your cover.
body: Moving home, getting married, having a baby or changing jobs can all change what your family would need if something happened to you. Review your protection when life changes.

When did you last check your protection?

Life insurance, critical illness cover and income protection are often set up once and then forgotten. But life does not stand still.

Moving home, getting married, having a baby or changing jobs can all change what your family would need if something happened to you.

A simple habit: review your cover whenever life changes, so it still fits the life you have now.

For employers, this is part of what Get Perks offers your people: protection advice from brokers who do the work, start to finish, free to them.
